items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: I don't know if you remember the Cab Calloway thing.

ctx.x: Can you tell me what a zoot suit was?

Yeah, well, I don't know if you remember the Cab Calloway thing. It was the big hat with the feather in it and the long coat with the chad and the tight-legged pants. Well, I had a gray suit suit when I went in there. And I got to Chicago, and it was cold. And I didn't have no overcoat, because we didn't even need no overcoat down here. And, well, after a week or two, I think they made up the companies, and then we had three months of boot training. And I was punished twice, neither time seriously, in boot…
Where would y'all go on Liberty?
